| description = 

A named gelatinous cube, smaller and weaker than its gooey cousins, which would explain why it had to prey upon children.

Rarely drops A Small Tattered Dress which belonged to Lucie Elron. It has 'a sewer rat' and 'a gelatinous cube' as placeholders. You'll know the sewer rat placeholder by its' size -- it's smaller than the other sewer rats.

The mob path can go further into the sewers, but the initial route is a patrol around its spawn point (about 2m 20s after spawning) before venturing out, without stopping, until it despawns. The mob will be despawned right about 5m after popping, causing a new Cuburt or PH to naturally spawn every 5m 15s or so.

The spawn point cycles every 20 seconds. 


''64 Cuburt kills, 11 dresses, 3 earrings''
